notes: Verified against the official Datavideo spec-sheet export (datavideo.com/us/product/HDR-90) and the official Instruction Manual PDF (resource.datavideo.com/Instruction_Manuals/HDR-90_E5_A4_EN.pdf), which includes the rear-panel connector diagram. SDI grade for the combo 3G/12G-SDI IN1 and OUT ports is set to sdi-12g (max supported, per SMPTE 2082 spec listed); the 3x SDI IN2-4 ports are 3G/HD only (sdi-3g). DC power input is a locking/screw-ring DC barrel connector (12V) per the manual's rear-panel description ("screwing the outer fastening ring of the DC In plug to the socket"), mapped to dc-barrel. GPI is a 3.5mm phone-jack control port (mapped to trs-3.5, no grade - control signal not audio). Genlock IN/OUT and Time Code IN/OUT are BNC sync/reference ports, not bandwidth-graded (no grade set, consistent with rule to omit grade for non-listed scales). Front-panel USB-A port and SD card slot are explicitly labeled "Reserved for future development" in the manual; USB-A port included as a physical port with no grade (version unstated/inactive) - SD card slot omitted as it is a media slot, not a signal/power connector. Front panel also has a 3.5mm stereo earphone/audio-monitor jack (TRS-3.5, output) not shown on rear panel diagrams. Ethernet port is labeled "DVIP" on the unit but functions as a standard RJ45 Ethernet control port; no speed/grade stated in specs so grade omitted.
